column4: Prior full negative resolution credited to Adrien Dubouloz–Karol Palka, The Jacobian Conjecture fails for pseudo-planes, Advances in Mathematics 339 (2018), 248–284, Theorem D (including converse) and Example 4.3. On the smooth normal affine complex surface x²y=z²−1, the globally étale selfmap (2xz,y,2z²−1) commutes with the identical effective Gm action of weights (1,−2,0), while its invariant quotient C[z] induces z→2z²−1, ramified at zero. The selfmap misses the entire line {y=0,z=−1}; surjectivity is absent from the original question, and no added-surjectivity version is resolved.
